summary.text: Tony Wilt is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 34th District since June 24, 2010.
The district covers part of Rockingham County and the City of Harrisonburg.
The House profile lists Tony Wilt's occupation as president/general manager of Superior Concrete, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Tony Wilt was born in Harrisonburg, VA.
The profile lists Broadway High School (1979), an A.A. from Blue Ridge Community College (1994) and a Bachelor of Applied Ministry from Cornerstone Bible College (2005).

The profile lists Truth and Grace Ministries (elder), the Virginia Small Business Commission (chairman), the board of visitors of the Virginia School for the Deaf and the Blind, and the Bergton Ruritan.
Tony Wilt serves on the Public Safety, Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources, and Labor and Commerce committees.
